body:
Worker rule (Termal::Opus-Causal, 2026-11-26, my own miss on w-a702b21c18b1, caught by Opus2 TermAl mailbox aecfe5b2 #564).

When I release a superseded candidate's runner paths for cleanup, I release ONLY the worktree root, for example DL560 .tmp/a702-<commit8>-c6. I never release the matching .evidence/<name> archive while its item is still open. Per Greg's rule, a run's archive stays in .evidence until every item it serves has closed, even when that run's candidate is superseded. Item notes cite those runs, so their originals must remain readable.

My miss: in relay #104 (R6) and #114 (R8) I named both the root and the archive. C6 removed .evidence/a702-47bdded3-c6 and .evidence/a702-bfb0e5fd-c6 while w-a702 was still open. Those originals now survive only as recorded on the item.
